categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Wahlap Technology Corporation Limited primarily operates in the commercial game amusement equipment industry, covering design, research and development, production, sales, and operation of game amusement devices. Its main business segments include game amusement equipment sales, anime IP derivative product sales, equipment cooperative operation, and amusement park operation services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as body-sensing interaction, virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), mixed reality (MR), and AI-assisted game design. It follows ISO9001:2015 quality management standards in production, with a complete product development cycle from design, prototyping, testing to manufacturing. The company also develops cross-platform software engines and integrates IP content with hardware to enhance user experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large-scale theme parks, international shopping centers, commercial real estate, high-end department stores, global hotel chains, and tourist attractions. The company serves both domestic and overseas markets, with a focus on indoor amusement venues, family entertainment centers, and commercial complexes. Major clients include well-known domestic and international chain brands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant presence in Guangdong province, including Guangzhou and surrounding cities. It also has overseas operations and sales channels, notably through its Hong Kong subsidiary and partnerships in Japan and other international markets. Overseas sales accounted for over 13% of revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangzhou Wahlap Technology occupies a midstream position in the supply chain as a manufacturer and operator of commercial game amusement equipment. It integrates upstream design and R&D with downstream sales and operation services, forming a complete industry chain from product development to end-user entertainment services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on IP-centric ecosystem development, integrating content, scene, and consumption to build differentiated competitive advantages. It invests heavily in R&D to advance AI, VR/AR/MR technologies, and data analytics to enhance product innovation and user experience. The strategy includes expanding terminal equipment deployment, deepening data-driven operations, and leveraging capital markets for sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of game amusement equipment and anime IP derivative products, cooperative operation income from equipment placed in client venues, and self-operated amusement park services. The company also earns from licensing and IP-related merchandise sales, with a mix of product sales and service-based recurring income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the commercial game amusement equipment sector, recognized as a market leader with strong brand influence and industry standards contribution. It competes with numerous small and medium enterprises domestically and faces international competition from established global firms like SEGA and Bandai Namco. Its competitive edge lies in its complete industry chain, IP partnerships, and technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.02 billion, a 24.65% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 84.65 million, up 62.93%. Total assets reached RMB 1.31 billion, growing 12.72%, with net assets of RMB 749 million. The company shows a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding sales and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes creating joyful user experiences through green culture, creative technology, and immersive entertainment. Its unique value proposition includes a full industry chain integration, strong IP ecosystem with global partnerships, advanced technology adoption (VR/AR/MR, AI), and a diversified product portfolio catering to entertainment, family interaction, and fitness. This differentiation enables it to offer innovative, high-quality amusement solutions with strong market appeal.
